records.title: MuirBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robust Multi-image Understanding
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・主題はLLM推論の計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの具体的改善を示さず、対象系統との妥当な技術接続も確認できない。

records.title: d1: Scaling Reasoning in Diffusion Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The primary text trains diffusion LLMs with reinforcement learning for reasoning quality. It is in the linked diffusion-LLM family, but its measured contribution is post-training capability rather than inference speed, memory, or serving.

records.title: Mathematical exploration and discovery at scale
records.reason: The primary text evaluates AlphaEvolve as an evolutionary coding agent for mathematical discovery. It does not present LLM inference kernels, runtime compilation, or serving optimization.

records.title: WebAgent-R1: Training Web Agents via End-to-End Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The primary paper trains web agents using end-to-end multi-turn reinforcement learning and evaluates task success; it does not improve LLM serving/scheduling.
